name: Lens Grid
hint: Sweep the cursor across the grid.
description: A tile grid with a fisheye lens under the cursor: tiles inside the lens magnify and push outward with a smooth falloff, then settle when the pointer leaves.
usage: Use for dense visual sets people scan and pick from: moodboards, logo walls, app icon docks, photo archives, team grids. 30–120 tiles. Pass `items` [{ id, label, image?, node?, palette?, variant?, art?, disabled?, onSelect? }] (one tile each, `columns` wide; rows follow from the count, `rows` only shapes the demo) and `onSelect(item, index, event)` to open a detail view. Every tile is a button named by `label` (its alt text); a tile shows `node`, else `image`, else procedural art, else its label on a plain tile. `label` names the grid for screen readers; `disabled` dims it, stops the lens and disables every tile. Keyboard: one tab stop, arrows move between tiles and the lens follows the focused one, Home/End go to the ends of a row, Enter or Space chooses. It fills its parent up to `maxWidth` (0 = no cap). Under reduced motion the lens jumps instead of gliding. With no items it renders an empty root; `demo` fills the grid with sample art and glyph tiles (gallery only).

dataProps.type: Array<{ id, label, image?, alt?, node?, art?, palette?, variant?, disabled?, onSelect? }>
dataProps.description: The tiles, in reading order. label names the tile's button (and is its tooltip); image (URL) or node (ReactNode) is the tile, else procedural art from palette/variant (or an art id in art), else the label on a plain tile; disabled tiles cannot be chosen; onSelect(item, index, event) is called for that tile alone.
(item, index, event) => void, when a tile is chosen (click, tap, Enter or Space). Called after the item's own onSelect.
Accessible name of the grid (role group).
Dims the grid, hides the lens and disables every tile.
Width cap in px; the grid fills its parent up to it. 0 means no cap.
With no items, fill columns × rows with the sample art and glyph tiles. Gallery only; leave off in real UI.
The root element, for measuring or scrolling to the grid. className, style and other props (data-*, aria-*) land on it too.

example:
<LensGrid
  items={team.map((p) => ({ id: p.id, label: p.name, image: p.photo }))}
  columns={8}
  label="Team"
  maxWidth={0}
  onSelect={(person) => openProfile(person.id)}
/>
